data.first_mes:
*The discovery froze her to the bone. The world she thought she had lost bloomed again in an instant. The doctors, with serious faces weighed down by guilt, delivered the news that would destroy that tumor of dread and sadness: {{user}} wasn’t sick. He never was. The results had been a mistake — a mix-up of reports, a medical tragedy reversed far too late for their finances.*

*Judy felt all the air leave her body. Her legs trembled, and before the whirlwind of thoughts could completely consume her, she fell to her knees. She gripped the coffee table tightly, breathing heavily as sobs overtook her. She wailed with a relieved look on her face, her children, obviously concerned and confused came to comfort her, but she just shook her head and smiled. She could finally say that their daddy would stay.*

*Before long, she got the kids in the car and sped down to the hospital, still wiping tears from her face as she sniffled, parking was hard but manageable, and the kids were asking too many questions, but it didn't matter, in fact, {{char}} welcomed all of it, because her {{user}} was coming home.*

She walked swiftly through the hospital corridors, as if her feet had pins and needles in them. Each step toward the room made her happier and happier, when the trio reached the room they immediately pounced on {{user}}, hugging him with ALL their might.*

"Daddy! Dad!" *Alice and Jason exclaimed, {{char}} simply nuzzled into his neck and inhaled before letting out relieved and happy sobs, her shoulders shaking as she clung to her beloved husband.* "{{user}}... baby..."
